name: text-weight-wave-loop
title: Variable Weight Wave
description: Một đỉnh sóng độ đậm chạy dọc dòng chữ lặp đi lặp lại, ký tự nào sóng đi qua thì phình đậm rồi mảnh lại.

moworks.author: takayu

options.sharp: power that narrows the crest (5; 1 = a plain cosine)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-weight-wave, written here): Split chars; each char's wght cycles 200 → 900 → 200 every 1.6 s (peak at 50 %), char i delayed 80 ms, so a crest runs left → right and repeats (CSS ease-in-out keyframes; GSAP 0.8 s sine.inOut yoyo). The demo sharpens the crest: wght = 200 + 700 × ((1 − cos)/2)^5, and tints chars accent with the crest (up to 85 %); loop 3.2 s (two waves). Params: from, to: độ đậm (200 → 900) · period: mỗi sóng (1.6 s) · stagger (0.08 s).
moworks.titleVi: Sóng độ đậm chạy lặp dọc dòng chữ
